description:
Extend PlatformAdapter base class and all 8+ platform adapters to support
query plan capture. Add capture_query_plan() method that executes EXPLAIN,
parses output, and returns QueryPlanDAG. Integrate with execute_query() flow.

**Integration Strategy**:
- Modify base adapter to add capture_query_plan() abstract method
- Each platform implements method using its parser
- execute_query() optionally captures plan based on --capture-plans flag
- Graceful handling when parser unavailable or fails
